t: A pocket mesh radio and GPS tracker for off-grid text messages.
steps: Buy it from the Seeed Studio store or a shop such as The Pi Hut.
Charge it with the included USB-C cable.
Install the free Meshtastic app on your phone.
Pair the tracker with your phone over Bluetooth.
Set your region so the radio uses the right channel.
Send a test message to a friend with another Meshtastic radio.
Update the firmware by holding the button while plugging in and dropping a UF2 file on the drive.
